verdict: Leads surged this week, but none have entered your intake pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 50 leads from Meta at a cost of $35.33 per lead — a 40% drop in cost per lead on 82% more leads week-over-week, a real efficiency gain. The immediate concern is that none of those leads have progressed into your intake pipeline as opportunities, meaning the volume improvement has not yet translated to cases. The two tools needed to reach leads quickly — SMS automation and phone access — are not yet live, and getting those active is the priority action this week. Once contact capability is in place, the lead volume now coming in gives you a strong base to convert from.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, the strongest volume of this campaign
cost per lead this period, down 40% from the prior week
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, clicks, and map interactions from organic search

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not being reached — SMS automation and phone access are not yet live, leaving the intake pipeline at zero.
watch_item.fix: Both tools are being activated now so that incoming leads can be contacted promptly before the next reporting period.
